date_basis: UTC. The November 20 captures cover AA’s live v5.0.1 methodology, homepage, leaderboard, changelog and model pages. Historical v5.0 values use dated Internet Archive captures of AA pages. Each source ID resolves to retrieval metadata in evidence/sources.json.
evidence_label: Third-party task-suite results published by Artificial Analysis. The atlas records AA endpoint scores and does not reproduce the evaluation on a B300 deployment.

index.name: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
index.scale: 0-100 weighted average; AA leaderboards display integer-rounded values

v5.0.effective: October 2026 to November 2026 per AA version history; AA changelog dates the v5.0 methodology update and v5 announcement 2026-10-27. Last archived capture labelled v4.3.2 is 2026-10-28T01:03:49Z; first labelled v5.0 is 2026-10-29T01:01:15Z; latest labelled v5.0 used here is 2026-11-03T19:33:41Z.
changes_from_v4_3_2: CritPt replaced by CritPt v2 (Hard Subset) at 10%
Removed GDPval-AA, SciCode, AA-LCR and Humanity's Last Exam
Category weights rebalanced to Knowledge Work, Coding, Science and General at 25% each

v5.0.1.effective: AA changelog dates the v5.0.1 methodology update 2026-11-03; the latest v5.0-labelled capture (2026-11-03T19:33:41Z) shows rollout after that time. The November 6 and November 20 captures both show v5.0.1.
changes_from_v5_0: CritPt v2 regraded for all models with grading-robustness improvements from the CritPt authors; weights and components unchanged

components.scoring: Combined Elo; index uses clamp((Elo - 500) / 2000) on the Elo frozen at model addition
Objective completion; zero credit on guardrail violation
AA runs Cognition's 132 tasks three times with Stirrup and a GPT-6 Luna (medium) judge. A failed blocking check or a flagged solution lookup scores zero.
Official grading server, pass@1, 40 problems x 5; regraded in v5.0.1

index.composite_rule: Index = 100 x sum(weight x normalized component). In the November 20 selection, every published composite has all ten components and every incomplete record has a null composite.
index.testing_parameters: AA defaults to temperature 0 for non-reasoning and 0.6 for reasoning models, with lab-specific exceptions. The non-reasoning output limit is 16,384 tokens or the model's lower cap. Reasoning models use the creator's output cap. Where pass@1 applies, AA averages the attempts. Each effort has its own entry.

verification.v5_0_to_v5_0_1_delta: Across 44 variants scored in both versions, the published index delta equals ten times the CritPt v2 Hard delta to the recorded precision.
verification.reconstruction: Across 71 published v5.0.1 variants the largest absolute difference between the published composite and a reconstruction using unrounded page components and current Briefcase Elo is 0.202 points. AA uses the Elo frozen at model addition.
verification.archived_consistency: On November 6 the prior review checked the following historical scope. Across 19 archived model-page captures (2026-10-29T02:51:14Z to 2026-11-03T19:33:41Z) and 4 leaderboard captures (2026-10-29T01:01:15Z to 2026-11-01T01:04:03Z) labelled v5.0, no target variant record shows two different non-null values under the same AA record name. The only slug carrying two record names is mistral-large-4 (Mistral Large 4 Preview, then Mistral Large 4 (High)); see that release's aa_slug_history. glm-5-3-flash, kimi-k3-low, qwen3-8-27b-low and qwen3-8-27b-medium were null at 2026-10-29T14:59:06Z and had scores by 2026-10-29T22:52:11Z in the newly retrieved capture; qwen3-8-27b-non-reasoning first appears with a value at 2026-11-01T18:03:13Z. On November 20, ten additional v5.0-labelled pages were inspected. Two captures each contain Gemini 4 Carbon Medium (57.709), Gemini 4 Carbon Low (53.721) and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 Max (32.490). Neither DeepSeek release-page capture contains the High score. Four other model pages captured November 2–3 embed the full High record at 28.544. The latest of these embeds 723 variant records and agrees with all historical scores and composite nulls from the 50 variants present in the November 6 catalog, including the three previously missing values now recovered. A separate replay check matched the registered response hashes for 32 of the 34 earlier v4.3.2/v5.0 URLs. The October 29 02:51:14Z request now redirects to 07:59:48Z on that day, and the October 30 00:20:19Z request now redirects to October 29 22:52:11Z. The exact replay timestamps identify the evidence available on November 20.
verification.release_level_objects: The November 6 GLM-5.3 page capture included a Claude Fable 5.1 release summary of 50.022, equal to Xhigh. The November 20 variant records show 50.022 for Xhigh and 49.160 for Max. Kimi K3 Low (17.419) is the highest scored variant of that deprecated release. The catalog computes each headline from variants.
verification.homepage_crosscheck: The November 20 homepage and default leaderboard each embed 13 atlas variant scores. Every score equals its model-page record.
verification.independent_corroboration: The same-publisher comparisons and archive agree on the checked values. No independent run of the complete AA suite was established.

applicability: Scores describe AA runs of each lab or provider endpoint at the stated effort setting. They do not identify the catalog revision, the NVFP4/MXFP4/FP8 export, the engine, KServe path or B300 node.
A quantized export or different chat-template, reasoning-budget or tool-call configuration requires its own quality evaluation; the AA composite does not transfer to it.

Effort variants differ substantially (for example Claude Opus 5.5 Low 34.75 versus Max 59.11 in v5.0.1). Compare like-for-like effort settings and report token use and cost per task alongside the index.
Null composites mean incomplete AA coverage, not a zero score. Do not substitute a neighbouring variant, successor release or older index version.
